verdict.rationale: Paddle.js lets developers add checkout directly to their app or website, and the inline checkout embeds the checkout and item/total display in your own interface 'fully integrated with your app'. An overlay option also keeps customers on-site, so there is no hosted-page redirect. Missing for 10: specific documentation of customization depth (styling/theming options, configurable fields), independent or hands-on corroboration of the embedded experience.
